mapper.sql: session_id, user_id, tab_type, active_host_ids, last_active_at, whitelist, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_session(session_id, user_id, tab_type, active_host_ids, last_active_at, create_time) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{tabType}, #{activeHostIds}, #{lastActiveAt}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_session SET last_active_at = #{lastActiveAt}, active_host_ids = #{hostIds} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT content FROM ai_message WHERE session_id = s.session_id AND role = '0' ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS preview FROM ai_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.tab_type = #{tabType} ORDER BY s.last_active_at DESC LIMIT 50
